content.text:
“**Businesses owned by responsible and organized merchants will eventually surpass…**”

A few natural ways to complete it:

1. **“…those run by careless and disorganized competitors.”**
2. **“…businesses managed without discipline or long-term planning.”**
3. **“…their rivals through consistency, trust, and efficient management.”**
4. **“…less reliable competitors in both reputation and profitability.”**
5. **“…others because responsibility and organization create lasting success.”**

A polished full sentence could be:

**“Businesses owned by responsible and organized merchants will eventually surpass those run by careless competitors.”**
